art_direction.concept: Swiss Precision meets Clinical Warmth. An Awwwards-level execution for medical B2B manufacturing. The design relies on high-contrast clinical spaces (stark whites and deep midnight slates), layered with warm coral accents to evoke human motion and vitality.

spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for section paddings. Ensure containers with borders have internal p-6 or p-8 padding.

grids.strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol for feature showcases (High Density Grid for Dashboards). Use asymmetrical layouts for Marketing pages. Overlapping elements to break generic blocky structures.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling (momentum-based) is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line masked reveal for the Kinetic Hero headline.
motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on all cards (scale-105 on image hover, button magnetic effect), staggered entrance animations for grid items.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the '3D Studio' section and Hero image.

component_treatments.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use Accent (Coral), Secondary buttons use outline with Clinical Sapphire.
component_treatments.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl). Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border/60), no harsh drop shadows. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
component_treatments.glassmorphism: Used selectively in sticky header and floating WhatsApp CTA (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px white/40 border). DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.

3d_libraries_and_effects.recommendation: Use framer-motion for UI choreography (scroll reveals, masking). Use Spline or a high-quality looping video for the 3D Studio showcase to maintain performance while delivering Awwwards-level immersion.
3d_libraries_and_effects.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a slow, editorial ribbon (e.g., repeating 'Moves You Forward — Clinical Precision — Tailored P&O Solutions').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses a gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent) to pass APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Use .js extensions for your React components, not .tsx files.
Build out the routing for Home, /about, /products, /b2b-innovation-hub, and /contact-us.
Implement the Sticky navbar with Glassmorphism and the Partner With Us lead modal.
Build the Kinetic Hero with a masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion.
Implement the 'For Adults' and 'For Kids' pill/tag grids. Ensure high-density but clear typography.
Create the 3-step 'How We Work' horizontal timeline.
Create an admin dashboard (auth-protected) using Shadcn components (Tables, Cards) to view/filter leads. DO NOT use teal/blue for the dashboard accent.
Ensure generous padding throughout. Never center-align paragraphs; prioritize left alignment for readability.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
